overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the July 18 and July 21 minutes showed no outside deliberation on the police chief appointment, and the family-presence inference was conjecture.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board deliberated privately on appointing a new police chief, and that a candidate's family being present showed he was told in advance.
allegations.key_passage: Our review of the Board meeting minutes for July 18 and July 21 reveals no evidence that would support the inference that the Board members deliberated outside of those meetings.
